turns.question: Which day of the week had the highest average daily ad spend across all campaigns in September 2026, and what was that average in EUR?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric or dimension for average daily ad spend by day of the week, so I cannot name that weekday or its average. The closest metric, Ad spend (EUR), is available by calendar day for 1 to 30 September 2026 (daily totals from 180 to 250 EUR), and the data freshness statement is: "Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline."
